 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
The applicant has filed this first bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 7/3/2024, by Police Station-M.P. Nagar Bhopal Distt. Bhopal (M.P.), in connection with Crime No.118/2022, for the offence punishable under Section 420 and 120-B of the IPC.

entities.text: Police Station-M.P. Nagar Bhopal Distt. Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. It is the submission of learned counsel for applicant that the applicant is suffering confinement since 7/3/2024 and charge-sheet has already been filed and since matter pertains to documentary evidence, therefore, chance of tampering with evidence/witness is remote.
As per allegations, he changed the label to extract more money from the vendee.
He did not misrepresent regarding potency of drug.
Matter is triable by Magistrate.
Confinement amounts to pretrial detention.
He fairly submits that since applicant is a resident of Karnataka, therefore, he is ready to abide by the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.
Applicant undertakes to cooperate in investigation and trial.
Under these grounds, counsel prayed for bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the prayer.
and prayed for its dismissal.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5.

Considering the submission advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I deem it appropriate to allow this application but with certain stringent conditions.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
Out of these two sureties one shall be cash surety and another shall be local surety of State of M.P.
In case of any violation of bail conditions, cash surety shall be immediately forfeited.
7. Application stands allowed and disposed of.
8. A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE m/-
